messages:
alex_cs: Quick heads-up — Meadowlane onboarding: observed 2x p95 token latency spikes on their dedicated pool after traffic ramp. I think a preflight compact-model swap (redwood-compact-lite-v2 -> int8) + routing fallback to standard-hosted on spike could avoid SLA blips. Thoughts?

sam_se: Can you paste metrics? what's the p95, concurrency, and avg input lengths?

alex_cs: Last 24h p95 = 780ms, baseline target 300ms. Concurrency ~12 sustained, tailier at 5-10% longer sequences (avg seq 420 tokens). Cache hit rate ~18%.

maria_re: Agree with compact swap but want a canary first. Recommend 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100% with quality checks (perplexity + prompt-anchored evals).

jorge_eng: For canary config we can use routing policy: route.market='meadowlane' AND user_tier!='enterprise' to compact; auto-fallback to redwood-base-1 on latency > 900ms. Here's a quick rollout config:

```
routes:
  - id: meadowlane-compact-canary
    match: customer == "meadowlane"
    weight: 5
    model: redwood-compact-lite-v2-int8
    fallback: redwood-base-1
    slo: p95 < 500ms
```

sam_se: QA note: int8 gave ~1.9x cost reduction in perf tests but small tokenization differences for emojis and code blocks — add prompt set 001 to regression suite.

alex_cs: I'll coordinate enablement with Meadowlane PM and propose a 72-hour canary window. If regressions > 1.5% on quality metric, rollback. tagging @maria_re @jorge_eng

opsbot: schedule created — canary window 72h starting 2026-04-05T15:00Z. :white_check_mark:

maria_re: Sounds good. I'll prepare the regression dashboard and automated alert thresholds.

alex_cs: Thanks team — I'll send the customer note and arrange a quick sync with Meadowlane tomorrow.
